verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's API reference renders a live "Try it" playground for each endpoint, with generated multi-language request examples (e.g. Import Events). Downloadable OpenAPI specs for its APIs back it up. The probe's 404s were at guessed root paths, not the documented /openapi/ directory, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the playground runs successfully, and breadth across all endpoints is shown with only one example.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The API reference renders a live "Try it" API playground per endpoint
Every Mixpanel API is described by an OpenAPI specification. Use these to generate client code, validate requests
